measurement_scope: Independent Python discrete-event service model with fixed rank-6 cryptographic metadata and declared cost proxies. Not OMNeT++/INET, hardware measurements, externally calibrated controller coefficients, or original manuscript-result reproduction.
timing_override_policy: A duration override scales warmup and disturbance times by duration/300; the five-second control interval, sampling period, deadlines and drain remain unchanged.
gateway_policy: Keep the base gateway count for the research sizes; cap gateways and contention-domain counts by available nodes for smaller overrides.
comparison_scope: Common nominal initialization and shared candidate library. Preserve the existing admission gate G and DA-AHE's additional robust drift gate; do not claim identical admitted sets or action-specific DPP calibration.
